title: Age-Structured Harvesting Models: A Structural Comparison of Rate-Control and Effort-Control Optimality Systems
summary: We study optimal harvesting in continuous-time, age-structured population models of McKendrick--von Foerster type, and we compare two harvesting mechanisms. In the \emph{rate-control} formulation, harvesting enters the state equation as an additive removal term; in the \emph{effort-control} formulation, harvesting acts multiplicatively as an additional mortality intensity and the mortality coefficient depends on the aggregate stock.
